title: Fix mobilePlanets hydration mismatch
description: SpaceField.tsx mobilePlanets() runs during render behind typeof window check: server HTML has 3 planets, mobile client renders 2 → React hydration mismatch on every mobile load. Fix: compute in useEffect/useState mounted pattern, or render all and hide via CSS.
design: Replace render-time mobilePlanets() with useState(false) mounted + useEffect matchMedia check; until mounted render desktop list (matches SSR), or always render all planets and hide the 3rd via CSS media class.
acceptance_criteria: No hydration warning in mobile viewport; planet count consistent between SSR and client.

title: Fix reduced-motion resize leaving stale starfield
description: SpaceField.tsx: the reduce early-return (render once, line ~114) runs before the resize listener is registered (line ~155). Reduced-motion users who resize/orientation-change get a blank or stretched canvas. Fix: register a lightweight resize handler (resize + re-render static frame) before the reduce return.
design: Move resize listener registration above the reduce early-return; in reduce mode onResize should resize() + render() only (no star regen needed, or regen is fine — keep simple).
acceptance_criteria: With prefers-reduced-motion on, resizing the window re-renders the static starfield at the new size.

title: Fix planet drift snap-jump + desync planet loops
description: SpaceField.tsx:188-194. Planet x/y are single values with repeat:Infinity and times:[0,.5,1] — they animate 0→drift then teleport to 0 every 9s. Also all 3 planets share the same 9s duration/start, pulsing in sync. Fix: keyframe arrays [0,drift,0] for x/y, per-planet durations (7/9/11s) and phase offsets.
design: In planet motion.button animate: change x/y to [0, p.drift[0], 0] and [0, p.drift[1], 0]; move transition per-planet: duration 7+i*2 (7/9/11s), keep times [0,.5,1] easeInOut repeat Infinity.
acceptance_criteria: Planets drift back and forth smoothly with no visible jump; the three loops are visibly out of sync.

description: SpaceField.tsx. Canvas (opacity-80) and planets (initial={false}) appear at full opacity instantly while hero text staggers in — background 'snaps on'. Ramp canvas+planets opacity 0→1 over ~1s on mount so the hero feels choreographed.
design: Canvas: wrap in motion.div initial opacity 0 → animate 0.8 over 1s delay 0.2 (respect reduce: opacity final immediately). Planets: initial {opacity:0} animate to p.opacity with same ramp instead of initial={false}.
acceptance_criteria: Background visibly eases in on first paint; no flash of full-opacity canvas.

title: Lerp SpaceField mouse parallax
description: SpaceField.tsx:144-149. mx/my applied raw per mousemove → stars step rigidly to pointer. Ease toward target each frame (mx += (target-mx)*~0.06 in tick). Also eases back to center on mouseleave instead of snapping.
design: Add target vars tx,ty set in onMove/onLeave; in tick: mx += (tx-mx)*0.06, my += (ty-my)*0.06 before draw loop. Remove direct mx/my assignment in onMove.
acceptance_criteria: Parallax follows pointer smoothly and glides back to center on leave.

title: Line-masked hero headline reveal
description: app/page.tsx:21. The h1 ('Websites. / Business systems. / AI automations.') fades up as one block. Split each line into an overflow-hidden mask span and rise lines with small stagger (shared EASE, ~0.6s). Signature hero moment; keep reduced-motion behavior (no motion) intact.
design: Wrap each h1 line in span.block.overflow-hidden > inner motion.span variants {hidden:{y:'110%'},show:{y:0}}; parent h1 becomes variant child of MotionHero with staggerChildren ~0.12. Keep opacity on inner spans at 1 (mask does the work) — pairs with cvh.6 transform-only fix. Reduced-motion: variants skipped by MotionConfig.
acceptance_criteria: Each headline line rises from its own mask in sequence; reduced-motion shows text instantly; no layout shift.

title: Measure and fix hero headline LCP delay
description: app/page.tsx h1 is inside MotionHero/HeroItem: SSR HTML has opacity:0, visible only after hydration + 0.15s delay + 0.6s animation. LCP element invisible ~1s+ on slow devices. Measure LCP (Lighthouse/web-vitals); if regressed, switch hero reveal to transform-only or keep text visible in SSR.
design: Step 1: run Lighthouse (mobile, throttled) on /, record LCP. Step 2 (only if LCP >2.5s): switch HeroItem reveal to transform-only (y:18→0, no opacity) OR set initial opacity 0.01... prefer removing opacity from hero reveal and letting mask (cvh.7) carry the effect. Re-measure, record both numbers in bead before closing.
acceptance_criteria: LCP measurement recorded before/after; headline does not stay invisible past LCP target on throttled mobile.

title: Cap WorkBoard win-cell infinite pulse
description: WorkBoard.tsx:116. Winning cells animate scale with repeat:Infinity forever, even under the end-game stamp overlay. Cap at 2-3 cycles or stop when stamp mounts.
design: Change transition repeat:Infinity → repeat:2 (3 total cycles). Pulse lives under stamp overlay anyway; stamp appears ~same time so optionally drop pulse entirely — try repeat:2 first.
acceptance_criteria: Win-cell pulse stops after <=3 cycles or when the stamp appears.

title: Remove filter:blur(40px) from animating planets
description: SpaceField.tsx:186. Three 320-560px elements with filter:blur(40px) + box-shadow animate scale every frame → full repaint per frame, main GPU cost of the page. Bake softness into the radial-gradient background (already present) or put blur on a static layer behind a non-filtered animating child.
design: Delete filter:'blur(40px)' and boxShadow glow from the motion.button; soften by extending radial-gradient stops (e.g. colorf2 → color44 45% → color00 65%). Verify with DevTools paint flashing.
acceptance_criteria: No CSS filter on the animating element; visual result near-identical; no per-frame repaint of a blurred layer (check with DevTools rendering paint flashing).

title: Enhance: cursor glow on project cards
description: Radial glow tracks pointer within each Selected-work card. Matches spacefield parallax language.
design: On card pointermove set CSS vars --mx/--my (no react state); card background: radial-gradient(200px at var(--mx) var(--my), rgba(34,211,238,.08), transparent). Desktop only via pointer:fine media.

title: Enhance: scroll-driven hero exit
description: Spacefield/hero currently hard-cuts at section boundary on scroll. Fade + parallax canvas and hero copy at different rates as hero scrolls away.
design: useScroll({target: heroRef, offset:['start start','end start']}) → useTransform: canvas opacity 1→0, copy y 0→-60. motion style on existing wrappers; reduced-motion skips via MotionConfig.
